keyWhy.ko: 핵심은 «그러나 대항해 시대에는 어두운 면이 있었다(어두운 면)» 와 «대항해 시대는 새로운 연결과 함께 큰 고통도 가져오며 세계를 영원히 바꾸었다(결론)» 입니다. 초록색 문장이 정답이에요.
keyWhy.en: The key ideas are the dark side (the Age of Exploration had a darker side) and the conclusion (it changed the world forever, bringing new connections but also great suffering). The green sentences are the answers.

boxes.a: The Age of Exploration and its two sides
Plants, animals, and ideas moved between continents
Conquest, deadly diseases, and the slave trade

sumHowto.ko: 먼저 위 세 칸을 보고, 빈칸에 알맞은 단어를 고르세요.
sumHowto.en: Look at the three boxes, then choose the right word for each blank.

sum.pre: From the 1400s to the 1600s, European sailors crossed oceans in search of new trade
, gold, and spices. Inventions such as the magnetic
made these long voyages possible. The journeys connected continents, and foods such as
, corn, and chili peppers spread across the world. However, for the Indigenous peoples of the Americas, the voyages brought conquest and deadly
such as smallpox. Remembering both sides helps us understand history more
and ask who gets to tell the story.

words: His voyage was part of a period from the 1400s to the 1600s
Diseases such as smallpox, to which they had no immunity, killed a very large share of the population.
the body's ability to fight off a disease
the arrival of Europeans brought conquest, forced labor, and the loss of land
taking control of a land or people by force
a Spanish expedition first led by Ferdinand Magellan completed the first voyage around the world
a long trip by a group of people to explore a place
chili peppers eventually became a key ingredient in Korean food
one of the foods used to make a dish
For the Indigenous peoples of the Americas
belonging to the people who lived in a place first

qs.q: Why did smallpox kill a very large share of the Indigenous population?
qs.qko: 천연두는 왜 원주민 인구의 아주 많은 수를 죽게 했나요?
opts: They had no immunity to the disease
Smallpox came from eating chili peppers
European ships were too small to carry doctors
evs: Diseases such as smallpox, to which they had no immunity, killed a very large share of the population.
For the Indigenous peoples of the Americas, the arrival of Europeans brought conquest, forced labor, and the loss of land.
Plants, animals, and ideas moved between the Americas, Europe, Africa, and Asia in what historians call the Columbian Exchange.
The magnetic compass showed direction, and new ships called caravels could sail well against the wind.
why: 본문에 원주민들은 천연두 같은 병에 대한 면역이 없어서 아주 많은 사람이 목숨을 잃었다고 나와요.
The text says they had no immunity to diseases such as smallpox, so a very large share of the population died.

qs.q: In the text, what does "a darker side" mean?
qs.qko: 글에서 «a darker side(더 어두운 면)» 는 무슨 뜻인가요?
opts: The harmful and painful results of the voyages
The night side of the Earth that sailors could not see
The dark color of the new sailing ships
evs: For the Indigenous peoples of the Americas, the arrival of Europeans brought conquest, forced labor, and the loss of land.
These journeys connected continents as never before.
Several inventions made these long voyages possible.
His voyage was part of a period from the 1400s to the 1600s that is often called the Age of Exploration.
why: «darker side» 는 나쁘고 고통스러운 결과를 뜻해요. 바로 다음 문장에서 정복, 강제 노동, 땅을 잃은 일을 말해요.
A darker side means harmful results. The next sentence describes conquest, forced labor, and the loss of land.

qs.q: How did chili peppers become part of Korean food?
qs.qko: 고추는 어떻게 한국 음식의 재료가 되었나요?
opts: Plants moved between continents in the Columbian Exchange, and chili peppers spread to Korea
Columbus brought chili peppers from Spain to Korea himself
Chili peppers first grew in Korea and then spread to the Americas
evs: Plants, animals, and ideas moved between the Americas, Europe, Africa, and Asia in what historians call the Columbian Exchange.
Potatoes, corn, and chili peppers spread across the world, and chili peppers eventually became a key ingredient in Korean food.
During this time, European sailors crossed oceans in search of new trade routes, gold, and spices such as pepper and cinnamon.
European powers also expanded the Atlantic slave trade, forcing millions of Africans across the ocean.
why: 식물, 동물, 생각이 대륙 사이를 오간 콜럼버스 교환으로 고추가 전 세계로 퍼졌고, 결국 한국 음식의 중요한 재료가 되었어요. 두 문장을 이어 봐야 해요.
In the Columbian Exchange, plants moved between continents. Chili peppers spread across the world and became a key ingredient in Korean food.

ends: How did sailors find their way across the ocean without GPS?
GPS 없이 선원들은 어떻게 바다에서 길을 찾았을까?
When did chili peppers arrive in Korea, and how did kimchi change?
고추는 언제 한국에 들어왔고, 김치는 어떻게 바뀌었을까?

write.howtoKo: 예문을 틀로 삼아, 빈칸 두 곳을 «중요한 일 + 그 이유» 로 바꿔 영어로 써 보세요.
write.howtoEn: Use the example as a pattern. Write an important action and your reason in English.
write.src: “It is important to <u>remember both sides of history</u> because <u>it helps us understand the past more honestly</u>.”

chips.a: listen to both friends after an argument
chips.b: each person may see it differently
chips.label: friends

chips.a: read more than one book about a topic
chips.b: one writer may tell only one side
chips.label: books

chips.a: ask our grandparents about the past
chips.b: they remember things our textbooks leave out
chips.label: family

write.moreKo: 한 걸음 더: «because» 뒤에 «누구의 이야기를 + 왜 들어야 하는지» 를 넣어 이유를 분명하게 써 보세요. (예: because every side has its own story)
write.moreEn: One more step: after «because», write whose story we should hear and why. (e.g. because every side has its own story)
